SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FICTIONAL PATIENT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE
EGD AND COLONOSCOPY REPORT
Facility: Silverbrook Endoscopy Center (fictional)
Patient: Nathaniel Ruskin (fictional)
Date of service: November 2, 2026
Endoscopist: Adaeze Montclair, MD (fictional)
Indication: Iron deficiency anemia.
EGD: The gastroscope was advanced to the second portion of the duodenum.
EGD findings: normal esophagus; mild antral erythema; mildly scalloped duodenal folds.
EGD biopsies: cold forceps biopsies of the second portion of the duodenum for celiac disease.
Cold forceps biopsies of the gastric antrum were also taken for Helicobacter pylori.
Colonoscopy: The colonoscope was then advanced to the cecum; the appendiceal orifice was seen.
Colonoscopy findings: a 2 cm patch of erythema in the sigmoid colon; otherwise normal.
Colonoscopy biopsy: cold forceps biopsies were taken from the sigmoid erythema.
Impression:
1. Scalloped duodenal folds and antral erythema, biopsied.
2. Patchy sigmoid erythema, biopsied.
Plan: Await pathology; continue oral iron.
